Proof methods: 48 individually rewritten solutions

Read the revised proof bank. Eight question tables, a question-specific integer-shift diagram, seven detailed mathematical constructions and eighteen final proof rules accompany the retained full university instruction and its 22 derivation tutorials. Each solution states the domain, derives its result, analyses alternatives and checks the meaningful boundaries.

Original images exposed a consequential transcription error in PhD CS 1405 Q19: the original claims identity, not injectivity. A strictly increasing integer shift refutes that claim; only the well-orderability assertion is true, giving independently derived option 2. The correction is applied in both authentic placements, proof and functions. The relations chapter has only a pattern reference. Functions still awaits its complete individual review.

There are 269 recorded exact-model, symbolic-identity, source and preservation checks with explicit finite bounds. Five proof animation scenarios passed geometry checks at 17 checkpoints; both static diagrams, fonts, phone, tablet, desktop and print were checked. The five prior university-course readings are reused within their documented source-audit boundaries. Required explanation standard

Each rewritten solution must explain the derivation, mathematical calculation or proof, conceptual meaning, incorrect options and relevant boundary cases. Diagrams must use the actual question data when needed. Short formula-only answers and unrelated repeated animations do not satisfy this standard.
